requirements: Use the existing grouped horizontal edition UI for one pending pair, including completed-album pairs.
Keep keep/partial/remove, Ctrl/Shift selection, hidden-selection preservation, fingerprint/revision safety and native validation unchanged.
During the review-required sequence, keep the same dialog open and show the next prefetched review immediately after submitting.
Serialize mutations in the background; do not treat submitted, stale, failed or partial work as complete.
Retain each review draft and failed review; background settlement must not reopen a user-hidden dialog.
Do not interrupt native downloads, hashing, recordings or other media work. Never modify real albums for tests.
supersession: Close-after-apply remains for standalone review only. The latest request overrides it for the review-required sequence.
changes: Three-review read-ahead using existing revision cache

validation.nativeQa: Isolated native QA app starts and renders staged frontend; closed gracefully through app-owned channel. User-owned desktop input was not taken over.
validation.interactiveQa: Pending actual Ctrl/Shift and continuous-apply interaction in native window. User desktop was occupied. No real album action performed.
validation.visualInspection: Captured 1920x1080 and 1280x720 scenes inspected; processing/retry bar and completed-pair rescan moved into header after detecting an overlap.

integration.reason: No native files, configuration, dependencies or executable changes. Retain running main app and ffmpeg PIDs; navigation checkpoint is preserved. No open review observed before integration.
